card.name: Inside receptor and enzyme names
card.fires_on: Partway through receptor and enzyme names such as NMDA, P2Y12 and CYP2D6, on the piece just before the next part of the name. It also fires weakly on small linking words in drug interaction passages.

modes.label: Receptor/enzyme name parts
modes.description: The digit or syllable inside names like P2Y12, CYP2D6 or N-methyl-D-aspartate.
